data.text: AR software tools can be categorized by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology. There are four categories of AR software tools arranged by decreasing programming skill: low-level libraries, rapid prototyping tools, plugins, and standalone authoring tools. These range from libraries requiring strong coding to standalone tools that require no programming knowledge.
points: AR software tools can be categorized by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology.
AR software tools are arranged in four categories according to decreasing programming skill: low-level libraries, rapid prototyping tools, plugins, and standalone authoring tools.
The requirements range from low-level libraries requiring strong coding to standalone authoring tools requiring no programming.

data.text: Low-level AR libraries provide core tracking functionality but require high developer skill and often lack built-in realistic rendering or interaction support. Developers can overcome these limitations by combining tracking-focused libraries like ARToolKit with scene graph libraries like Open Scene Graph to manage 3D graphics. These combinations are used in various frameworks and mobile-specific toolkits.
points: Low-level AR libraries provide core tracking but require high developer skill and often lack realistic rendering or interaction support.
Scene graph libraries, such as Open Scene Graph (OSG), organize 3D graphics scenes as node-based trees to manage rendering, visibility, and state.
Combining a tracking library like ARToolKit with a scene graph library allows developers to focus on interaction while the scene graph handles low-level object rendering.
Various frameworks and mobile-specific toolkits integrate these tracking and rendering technologies for different platforms.

data.text: Low-level AR libraries provide maximum flexibility but require significant programming skill and time, while rapid prototyping tools allow for the visualization of ideas before major development. Adobe Flash can be used with plugins like FLAR Toolkit or FLAR Manager to prototype AR experiences in a web browser with minimal effort using a few lines of code. FLAR Manager combines tracking and 3D graphics libraries primarily for prototyping rather than full-fledged development.
points: Low-level AR libraries provide maximum flexibility but require significant programming skill and time.
Rapid prototyping tools allow for the visualization of ideas before major development so that unsuitable ideas do not require further coding.

FLAR Manager combines tracking and 3D graphics libraries primarily for prototyping rather than full-fledged development.
